_status: DRAFT, proposed for the registration, not frozen, not run

_rationale.fixed: tail range and final derivative thresholds from the 2026-09-21 code review; at rtol 1e-6 they sit at the solver's noise floor and reject converged fixed points, at rtol 1e-8 converged fixed points fall 10x inside them (results/audit/classifier_calibration*.json)
_rationale.oscillatory: tail range above 1e-4, inside [0, 1] up to the margin, and each half of the tail repeating the other's per-node maximum and minimum to within 2.5% of that node's range; nodes whose range is within the fixed-point bound count as static and are not compared. 2.5% sits about 2.5x above the largest disagreement of a sustained oscillation (0.0098) and about 2x below the smallest of a decaying one (0.053, the 3-node ring just below onset); every tolerance from 1% to 5% classified the validation panel identically (results/audit/oscillation_tolerance_replay.json). Chosen in review 4.
_rationale.extension_horizons: 60 -> 120 -> 240 -> 480 -> 960, the tail kept at the final third of each horizon and sampled at constant density. 480 and 960 were added after calibration found damped oscillations near a Hopf point (arabidopsis_cellcycle, n_H = 2) that settle only by t ~ 400-800 (results/audit/classifier_calibration_rtol1e-8_arabidopsis_n2.json)
